spec.description: Dashboards for bird song monitoring solely based on Loki.

spec.expr:
avg(
  avg_over_time(
    {unit="birdnet_analysis.service"}
    | unpack
    | __error__=""
    | confidence > $threshold
    | species !~ "${exclude_species:pipe}"
    | unwrap confidence
    [$__auto]
  )
)

avg(
  avg_over_time(
    {unit="birdnet_analysis.service", species=~".+"}
    | unpack
    | __error__=""
    | confidence > $threshold
    | species !~ "${exclude_species:pipe}"
    | unwrap confidence
    [$__auto]
  )
)

max(
  max_over_time(
    {unit="birdnet_analysis.service", species=~".+"}
    | unpack
    | __error__=""
    | confidence > $threshold
    | species !~ "${exclude_species:pipe}"
    | unwrap confidence
    [$__auto]
  )
)

last_over_time(
  {job="weather"}
  | json
  | unwrap sunrise_unix
  | __error__=""
  [$__range]
) * 1000

last_over_time(
  {job="weather"}
  | json
  | unwrap sunset_unix
  | __error__=""
  [$__range]
) * 1000

spec.root_selector:
.daily
| def score($i):
    (
      (if ((.temperature_2m_max[$i] + .temperature_2m_min[$i]) / 2) >= 60
          and ((.temperature_2m_max[$i] + .temperature_2m_min[$i]) / 2) <= 80
       then 25
       elif ((.temperature_2m_max[$i] + .temperature_2m_min[$i]) / 2) >= 50
          and ((.temperature_2m_max[$i] + .temperature_2m_min[$i]) / 2) <= 90
       then 18
       else 10
       end)
      +
      (if .wind_speed_10m_max[$i] <= 5 then 25
       elif .wind_speed_10m_max[$i] <= 8 then 20
       elif .wind_speed_10m_max[$i] <= 12 then 12
       elif .wind_speed_10m_max[$i] <= 16 then 5
       else 0
       end)
      +
      (if .precipitation_probability_max[$i] <= 10 then 20
       elif .precipitation_probability_max[$i] <= 25 then 15
       elif .precipitation_probability_max[$i] <= 50 then 8
       else 0
       end)
      +
      (if .relative_humidity_2m_max[$i] >= 40
          and .relative_humidity_2m_max[$i] <= 70
       then 15
       elif .relative_humidity_2m_max[$i] >= 30
          and .relative_humidity_2m_max[$i] <= 80
       then 10
       else 5
       end)
      +
      (if .uv_index_max[$i] <= 7 then 15
       elif .uv_index_max[$i] <= 9 then 10
       else 5
       end)
    );

{
  activity_today: score(0),
  activity_tomorrow: score(1)
}

spec.expr:
topk(5,
  quantile_over_time(
    1,
    {unit="birdnet_analysis.service"}
    | unpack
    | species="$bird"
    | __error__=""
    | unwrap confidence
    [1h]
  ) by (species)
)

topk(5,
  quantile_over_time(
    0.75,
    {unit="birdnet_analysis.service"}
    | unpack
    | species="$bird"
    | __error__=""
    | unwrap confidence
    [1h]
  ) by (species)
)

topk(5,
  quantile_over_time(
    0.5,
    {unit="birdnet_analysis.service"}
    | unpack
    | species="$bird"
    | __error__=""
    | unwrap confidence
    [1h]
  ) by (species)
)

topk(5,
  quantile_over_time(
    0.25,
    {unit="birdnet_analysis.service"}
    | unpack
    | species="$bird"
    | __error__=""
    | unwrap confidence
    [1h]
  ) by (species)
)

topk(5,
  quantile_over_time(
    0,
    {unit="birdnet_analysis.service"}
    | unpack
    | species="$bird"
    | __error__=""
    | unwrap confidence
    [1h]
  ) by (species)
)
$threshold
avg_over_time({species="$bird"} | unpack | unwrap confidence [$__auto])
min(min_over_time({species="$bird"} | unpack | unwrap confidence [$__auto]))
sum(count_over_time({species="$bird"} [$__auto]))

sum by (le) (
  count_over_time(
    {unit="birdnet_analysis.service", species=~".+"}
    | unpack
    | __error__=""
    | confidence > $threshold
    | species !~ "${exclude_species:pipe}"
    | label_format le=`{{if gt (.confidence | float64) 0.9}}0.9{{else if gt (.confidence | float64) 0.8}}0.8{{else if gt (.confidence | float64) 0.7}}0.7{{else if gt (.confidence | float64) 0.6}}0.6{{else if gt (.confidence | float64) 0.5}}0.5{{else if gt (.confidence | float64) 0.25}}0.25{{else}}0.0{{end}}`
    | le > 0.0
    [$__auto]
  )
)
